2026-10-01T06:11:08.8824026Z   pr_title: Keep session data in permission-prompt issues inside code spans it cannot close — phase 1/1: code spans for session data and the spec rule
2026-10-01T06:11:08.8831388Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Fixes the security finding in #5810 (`unescaped-command-shape-in-class-comment`, `A03:2021-Injection`, medium). `permission_prompts.py` wrapped the command shape in a one-backtick code span on the `**Pattern:**` line of the class "Seen again" comment. A command word with a backtick and a newline could close that span and add Markdown, including forged instructions, to a comment posted as the owner, and `/implement-issue-claude` treats owner comments as spec.

- Plan: `docs/plans/issue-5810-escape-class-comment-pattern-plan.md` (phase 1/1)
- Progress log: `docs/implement-plan/issue-5810-escape-class-comment-pattern.md`
- Final PR: #5833 (draft, into the #4867 project branch)

2026-10-01T06:10:58.1242008Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Fixes the security finding in #5810 (`unescaped-command-shape-in-class-comment`, `A03:2021-Injection`, medium). `permission_prompts.py` wrapped the command shape in a one-backtick code span on the `**Pattern:**` line of the class "Seen again" comment. A command word with a backtick and a newline could close that span and add Markdown, including forged instructions, to a comment posted as the owner, and `/implement-issue-claude` treats owner comments as spec.

- Plan: `docs/plans/issue-5810-escape-class-comment-pattern-plan.md` (phase 1/1)
- Progress log: `docs/implement-plan/issue-5810-escape-class-comment-pattern.md`
- Final PR: #5833 (draft, into the #4867 project branch)

## Changes

- `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py`: new `_markdown_code_span` (line 627). It wraps an already-guarded line in a backtick run one longer than the longest run inside, and pads it with a space when the line starts or ends with a backtick. It is now used for:
  - every prompt reason (`_occurrence_block`, line 645);
  - the tool name and the `**Pattern:**` shape in `issue_body` (lines 658, 661);
  - the `**Pattern:**` shape and tool name in `class_comment_body` (line 695). This line now also goes through `_pattern_line`, so a `<!--` in the shape is escaped there too.
  - The module docstring is updated. `_pattern_line` and `_reason_line` keep their return values (§6). Signatures are unchanged.

2026-10-01T06:11:00.3613276Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Phase 1/1 of `docs/plans/issue-5144-merge-guard-effective-repo-plan.md` (issue mode). The §21 merged-PR guard now judges each guarded `git commit` / `git push` in the repository it actually runs in (earlier `cd <path>`, `git -C`, `GIT_DIR=` / `--git-dir`). For a push it judges the branch the push writes to (`<src>:<dst>` is checked on `<dst>`, with `<src>` as the tip). An unresolvable directory keeps the old behaviour and emits a warning.

**Protected path, twin-first** (interim automatic default until #4785): only `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` is edited. The root `.claude/hooks/` copy lands through a `[claude-twin-sync]` commit, so `test_template_copies_are_identical` stays red until then. A `hold` claim stops fix

2026-10-01T06:10:50.1987681Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Phase 1/1 of `docs/plans/issue-5144-merge-guard-effective-repo-plan.md` (issue mode). The §21 merged-PR guard now judges each guarded `git commit` / `git push` in the repository it actually runs in (earlier `cd <path>`, `git -C`, `GIT_DIR=` / `--git-dir`). For a push it judges the branch the push writes to (`<src>:<dst>` is checked on `<dst>`, with `<src>` as the tip). An unresolvable directory keeps the old behaviour and emits a warning.

**Protected path, twin-first** (interim automatic default until #4785): only `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` is edited. The root `.claude/hooks/` copy lands through a `[claude-twin-sync]` commit, so `test_template_copies_are_identical` stays red until then. A `hold` claim stops fixers in the meantime.

## Evidence (step 5)

- Command walker and refspec parser: `guard_targets`, `_git_invocation_targets`, `_push_refspec_targets`, `_cd_destination`, `_resolve_guard_path` in the twin. Tests: `test_cd_into_a_worktree_judges_the_worktree_and_the_target_ref`, `test_git_dash_c_is_followed_and_composes`, `test_git_dir_prefix_and_option_select_the_repository`, `test_push_refspecs_name_the_judged_branch_and_tip`, `test_deletions_tags_and_unguarded_calls_yield_no_target`, `test_unresolvable_directory_falls_back_to_the_session_checkout` (13 cases).
- Acceptance list of #5144, against real git repositories with a stubbed `gh`:
  - worktree `cd … && git push origin HEAD:<open-PR branch>` from a checkout stranded on a merged branch is allowed: `test_e2e_worktree_push_to_an_open_pr_branch_is_allow
